title: BlockTweaks
description: some tweaks to the block textures
body:
![Block Tweaks Logo V2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0fba6caa37f17317ef44242464643b0464464ce4.png)

# PLEASE READ
**This resource pack was made as practice for me. It may look bad. This resource pack will tweak more blocks in the future.**

Doesn't it suck that some doors aren't consistent with their trapdoor variant? And that you can't see through some of them? This resource packs makes so the doors match trapdoors (for doors that didn't) and also give the ability to see through the doors and trapdoors. And stained glass is just plain boring.

# FEATURES
- Makes the doors match their trapdoor variant, as well as being able to see through the doors.
- Makes all stained glass have a unique to it pattern.
- that's all basically
